title: Kohli's Unbeaten 105 Powers RCB to Top of IPL 2026 Table
excerpt: The 37-year-old silenced his critics with a record ninth IPL century and became the fastest player to 14,000 T20 runs.
body:
**The Innings:** Virat Kohli produced one of the great IPL chase innings on Tuesday night, smashing an unbeaten 105 off just 60 balls to power Royal Challengers Bengaluru to a six-wicket victory over Kolkata Knight Riders at the Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh International Stadium in Raipur. The win propelled RCB to the top of the IPL 2026 points table with 16 points from 12 matches, level with Gujarat Titans but ahead on net run rate.

Chasing KKR's competitive 192 for 4 — built around Angkrish Raghuvanshi's 71 and Rinku Singh's unbeaten 49 — RCB appeared in trouble at 48 for 2 in the powerplay. What followed was vintage Kohli: calculated aggression, impeccable timing, and an ability to accelerate precisely when the equation demanded it. His century, laced with 11 fours and three sixes, came at a strike rate of 175 and sealed the chase with five balls to spare.

**The Milestones:** The innings was drenched in history. It was Kohli's ninth IPL century, extending his own record by a considerable margin. More significantly, the knock took him past 14,000 runs in T20 cricket, making him the fastest player — and first Indian — to reach the landmark, surpassing Chris Gayle's previous mark.

At 37, Kohli's muted celebration spoke volumes. In post-match comments, he emphasized team goals over personal records, noting that RCB's focus remains on securing a top-two finish to earn a crucial double chance in the playoffs. The defending champions, who ended their trophy drought last season, are now firmly positioned to make a deep playoff run.

**The Diaspora Watch Party:** For the millions of Indian-Americans who set alarms for early-morning IPL streams, Kohli's century was the kind of appointment viewing that justifies those bleary 7 AM starts. RCB, with their passionate global fanbase and Kohli's transcendent appeal, remain the IPL's most-watched franchise in overseas markets — a reality that Disney+ Hotstar's streaming numbers consistently confirm.

**What to Watch:** RCB face two crucial league matches before the playoffs. A top-two finish would give them a shot at the Qualifier 1, avoiding the do-or-die Eliminator. With Kohli in this form, few would bet against it.
